role: Declares the stateless MainActor struct holding a strong HealthKitManager reference (its HRV/sleep writes, deletion and observers live in HealthKitManager+HRV.swift and +SleepTrends.swift) and its delete-forever removal of everything a session exported; the one replace operation every export uses: HealthSampleReplacement (what one replacement covers), the HealthSampleStore seam over query/save/delete, its HealthKit implementation HealthKitSampleStore, and HealthSampleReplacer (read earlier, save new, delete those read that the save did not replace through their sync identifier; serialized per key; the save and delete bounded by the write timeout); and HealthSampleWatch, the observer query plus persisted-anchor read that watches a type for other sources' samples, background deliveries included, one read per anchor key at a time (ReadGate: a fire during a read runs it once more when it ends).
types: HealthWriteAndObserve: struct — write/observe half of HealthKit, holds `manager`
HealthSampleReplacement: struct — type, search span, read timeout, label, serial key, ExternalUUID match, write timeout
HealthSampleStore: protocol — ownSamples (by span / saved with a workout) / save / delete
HealthKitSampleStore: class — HealthSampleStore over the manager's HKHealthStore and bounded query
HealthSampleReplacer: class — serialized replace of exported samples
HealthSampleWatch: enum — HKObserverQuery + anchored read of added samples, anchor kept in UserDefaults
HealthSampleWatch.ReadGate: struct (Sendable) — the anchor keys with a read under way, and whether a request came during it
state: mem:HealthSampleReplacer.tails ([serialKey: Task] last queued replacement per key)
mem:HealthSampleWatch.readGate (static ReadGate; OSAllocatedUnfairLock<[anchorKey: Bool]>: present while a read runs, true when it is to run once more)
toplevel: Type declarations; stored properties only outside the units.

units.does: Deletes everything the app exported to Apple Health for a session deleted forever: runs, in order and each whatever the others did, removeExportedHRV over the span, HeartRateHealthQueries.removeExportedHeartRate over the span, removeExportedRestingHeartRate dated at the span's end, removeExportedSleep, and HealthKitWorkoutExport.removeExports from the span's start; logs each failure as a warning and throws the first error once all have been tried.
reads: hk:heartRateVariabilitySDNN, heartRate, restingHeartRate, sleepAnalysis, workouts (own source)
writes: hk:heartRateVariabilitySDNN, heartRate, restingHeartRate, sleepAnalysis, workouts and their samples (deletes)

branches.effect: logged as a warning, the first error kept, the next removal runs

units.does: Protocol requirement: this app's own samples of a type within a span (all time when nil); throws on a query error or when the read does not answer within the timeout.
units.entry: Called through `any HealthSampleStore` by HealthSampleReplacer.replaceNow and HealthWriteAndObserve.deleteAllAppWrittenSleepSamples.

units.does: Protocol requirement: this app's own samples of a type saved with a given workout; throws on a query error or when the read does not answer within the timeout.
Protocol requirement: saves samples to the Health store; throws when the save fails.
Protocol requirement: deletes samples from the Health store; throws when the delete fails.
units.entry: Called through `any HealthSampleStore` by HealthSampleReplacer.replaceNow and deleteAllAppWrittenSleepSamples.

units.does: Stores a weak reference to the manager whose Health store it reads and writes.

Runs an unlimited HKSampleQuery for `type` with ownSamplesPredicate(in: span) (this app's source, and the span when given) through the manager's bounded throwing query; a timeout fails with queryTimedOut(label) (fail closed), a query error throws, otherwise returns the samples.

branches.cond: manager released, or the query fails or does not answer in timeout
branches.effect: throws (notAvailable, the query error, or queryTimedOut(label)), via ownSamples(of:matching:)

units.does: Runs the bounded, fail-closed read (ownSamples(of:matching:)) for `type` with this app's source AND HKQuery.predicateForObjects(from: workout): the app's samples of that type saved with the workout.
reads: hk:<type> saved with the workout (own source)

branches.cond: manager released, or the query fails or does not answer in timeout

units.does: Runs an unlimited HKSampleQuery for `type` with `predicate` through the manager's bounded throwing query; a timeout fails with queryTimedOut(label) (fail closed), a query error throws, otherwise returns the samples.

branches.cond: query does not answer in timeout

units.does: Saves the samples with the manager's HKHealthStore; throws its error.
Deletes the samples with the manager's HKHealthStore; throws its error.
Returns the manager, or throws HealthStoreError.notAvailable when it has been released.
Predicate for this app's own source (HKSource.default()); with a span, ANDed with a sample-date predicate over the span, an instant span widened to one second.
Stores the Health store the replacements read, save to and delete from.

Queues a replacement behind the last one with the same serialKey: starts a task that awaits the previous tail, then runs replaceNow; records a tail task that ends when this work ends, removes the tail entry when it is still its own once done, and rethrows the work's error. Replacements under different keys run concurrently.

branches.cond: a previous replacement under the key
branches.effect: waits for it to finish (success or failure) first

branches.cond: the key's tail is still this one

units.does: Reads this app's samples of the replacement's type in its span (store.ownSamples, fail closed on the read timeout), keeps those whose ExternalUUID `matches`, saves the new samples, then deletes the ones read that the save did not replace through their sync identifier (notReplacedBySync), the save and the delete each bounded by the replacement's writeTimeout, else its timeout (bounded, labelled '<label> save' / '<label> delete'), and logs what it wrote, removed and HealthKit replaced. A failed or timed-out read or save throws before anything is deleted; a failed or timed-out delete throws with the new samples saved.

branches.cond: nothing read is left once the save's own replacements are taken out

units.does: Returns the earlier samples a save did not replace itself: with no sync identifier among the saved samples, all of them; otherwise those whose sync identifier is not one of the saved samples' (or that carry none).

branches.cond: no saved sample carries a sync identifier
an earlier sample shares a saved sample's sync identifier

units.does: Runs `operation` on the main actor and returns when it finishes, rethrowing its error (outcome(of:)), or throws HealthKitError.queryTimedOut(label) once `timeout` seconds pass first; whichever comes first resumes the caller (resumingOnce), and the operation keeps running after a timeout.
Awaits `operation` and returns .success, or .failure with the error it threw.

Builds the HKObserverQuery for `type` (no predicate). Each fire (one when it starts, then one per change, background deliveries included): on an error, logs a warning; otherwise, while the store is alive, requests a read for the type and anchor key (requestRead: starts one, or has the one under way run again); then calls HealthKit's completion handler.
units.entry: The returned query's update handler runs on HealthKit's queue when the query starts and whenever samples of the type are saved or deleted.

branches.effect: logged as a warning, nothing read

units.does: Under the lock: true, and the key marked as read under way, when no read for `key` is; false when one is, which is then marked to run once more.

branches.cond: a read for the key is under way
branches.effect: marks it to run again, returns false
marks one under way, returns true

units.does: Under the lock, when the read for `key` ends: true, the key kept as under way with no further request, when a request came during it and `canRerun`; otherwise the key is freed and false.

branches.cond: no request came during the read, or it cannot run again
a request came and it can run again
branches.effect: keeps the key under way, returns true

units.does: Starts readAdded for `anchorKey` when the gate lets it begin (readGate.claimRead); when a read for it is under way, does nothing more: that read runs once more when it ends.

branches.cond: a read for the key is under way
branches.effect: returns; it runs again when it ends

units.does: Called when a read for `anchorKey` answers: when a request came during it and the store is still there (readGate.finishRead), starts readAdded again from the anchor that read kept; otherwise the key is freed.

branches.cond: no request during the read, or the store is gone

units.does: Executes an HKAnchoredObjectQuery for `type` from the anchor stored under `anchorKey` (no stored anchor: samples from the last 48 hours, no anchor). Its result: an error is logged and the anchor kept; otherwise the new anchor is stored, and the added samples other sources wrote (othersSamples) go to `deliver` when there are any. Either way the read then ends (readEnded), which runs it again when a request came meanwhile.

branches.effect: ends the read (readEnded) after handling it

branches.cond: no other source's samples were added

units.does: Returns the samples whose source is not this app (HKSource.default()).
Returns the HKQueryAnchor archived in UserDefaults under `key`: nil when none is stored, and nil (logged) when it cannot be unarchived.
Archives the anchor with secure coding and stores it in UserDefaults under `key`; a failed archive is logged and nothing is stored.
